Author: dPeluChe
Message:
feat: Claude Code harness hooks — PreToolUse git-guard + secret-guard (make harness) (#19)

git-guard.sh (matcher Bash) blocks destructive git before it runs: force
push (force-with-lease passes), hard reset, clean -f, branch -D,
filter-branch, stash drop/clear, whole-tree checkout discard, ref
deletion, plus our hook bypasses (verify-skip flag, LEFTHOOK disable
env). Exit 2 + stderr = the model reads the reason. Escape hatch:
FLOWKIT_GIT_GUARD=off (warns, passes).

secret-guard.sh (matcher Edit|Write) scans tool_input content/new_string
with gitleaks against hooks/.gitleaks.toml (resolved relative to the
script) and names the rule on a hit; regex fallback (dpat_, ghp_, sk-,
AKIA, private key headers, postgres URIs, ITERIS_SYNC_TOKEN) when
gitleaks is unavailable. Documented placeholders pass; .env* file_path
targets (except .env.example/.env.sample) block outright.

install.sh --harness (make harness) symlinks ~/.agents/hooks-harness ->
hooks/harness and merges both PreToolUse entries into
~/.claude/settings.json via python3 json stdlib: idempotent, backup to
settings.json.bak, everything else preserved verbatim. --check validates
link + entries once installed; never-installed machines stay green.

test-hooks.sh section 8: 17 new assertions (block/pass/escape-hatch
fixtures for git-guard, gitleaks + fallback fixtures for secret-guard,
merge idempotency against a seeded settings.json). 59 passed, 0 failed;
shellcheck clean.

Author: dPeluChe
Message:
feat: centralized git hooks (lefthook remotes + gitleaks) with repo installer (#15)

Adds the centralized hooks system served from this repo via lefthook remotes
(refetch_frequency: 24h), so every wired repo shares the same pre-commit and
pre-push guarantees without copying config.

- hooks/lefthook-base.yml: pre-commit (<2s, always runs) — gitleaks on staged
  (modern 'gitleaks git --staged' + remote config + optional baseline), hard
  block on staged .env* (except .env.example), LOC warning >500 lines (never
  blocks). pre-push (<30s) — embedded multiline wrapper that parses the
  '## ship config' block (exact heading + yaml fence) of the local CLAUDE.md
  at runtime, extracts lint:/typecheck: and runs them. Fail-soft: no block or
  no keys -> loud warning, push passes. Factory skips: docs-only pushes skip
  lint; deletion/tag-only pushes skip entirely.
- hooks/.gitleaks.toml: extends defaults with ghp_/dpat_/AKIA/Sentry DSN/
  postgres-with-password/ITERIS_SYNC_TOKEN patterns; allowlists lockfiles,
  docs/ paths and documented placeholders (dpat_<...> etc.).
- scripts/install.sh --repo <path> [--team] (phase 2, skills mode untouched):
  min-version checks (lefthook >= 1.10, gitleaks >= 8.19), solo -> lefthook.yml
  with remotes / team -> lefthook-local.yml + ensures it in the GLOBAL
  gitignore, chains after existing husky instead of replacing it, lefthook
  install, gitleaks baseline with findings summary table, FLOW_CLAUDE.md
  symlink + @import into the target CLAUDE.md, and a '## ship config' template
  stamp with TODOs. Normal sync mode now also links FLOW_CLAUDE.md.
- FLOW_CLAUDE.md: session/PR rituals in <=15 lines (kickoff resume / standup
  micro / ship; agents never bypass hooks — no verify flags, no LEFTHOOK=0).
- scripts/test-hooks.sh: extracts every run block from the YAML (yq or awk),
  shellchecks them (sh dialect) plus install.sh and itself, exercises the
  pre-push wrapper against CLAUDE.md fixtures (valid block, missing block,
  failing lint, docs-only skip, empty-push skip) and validates the gitleaks
  config against positive/negative secret fixtures. 15/15 green, exit 0.
- Makefile: install / check / prune / hooks REPO=... [TEAM=1] / test, with a
  self-documenting 'make help' default target.
- skills/ship/SKILL.md: new 'simplify: 500' schema key (run /simplify only
  when the diff exceeds the threshold; off = on request; per-area importance
  thresholds noted as future). LOC gate: files over the limit that are part of
  the current work get split in the same branch/cycle before the PR; legacy
  files barely touched become a docs/TASK_TODO.md task via pm-tasks instead of
  blocking.
- README.md: 'Hooks (lefthook + gitleaks)' section with the make-based
  install and the 4-layer table (pre-commit <2s / pre-push <30s / ship / CI).
